I liked it. Kind of interesting.

This would be a great opportunity for some HTML trickery where if you go to the page a second time it's a picture of a bear coming at the reader :)

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: If I must fit this story in the Foundation, I would say that it is a story in the Wanderer's Library. The bear would actually pop out and attack readers and other Library patrons.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Thanks. I was trying to work out a connection to something Foundation-related, but didn't see any obvious way to achieve it.

One could read the "boxes" section as a reference to the Foundation, although that was in there long before I knew about this site.

One could also speculate on whether my SCP-2673 collaborative submission was influenced by the fact that this was sitting in my sandbox at the time I wrote the poems.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I don't usually upvote creepypastas on this site, since I believe they're in a wrong place to begin with. However, this is inherently interesting enough for me to enjoy. Anyway, this feels more refreshing compared to other standard types of creepypasta.

Love the 4th wall breaking.

item.title: Re: Author post
item.content:encoded: You're quite right - always meant to add the creepypasta tag, and have done so now. Thanks!

item.title: Re: Author post
item.content:encoded:
Should there be another tag for this? Creepypasta perhaps? I know it's more of weird fiction, but not all the stuff in that section of the site is classic creepy anyway.

Edit: darling little tale, upvoted.

item.title: Author post
item.content:encoded: Just a very short fairy tale about pretty much exactly what you'd expect. No relation to anything on the site, per se. Hope you enjoy.
